notes.title: News !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41789163/d15d7ab3a632dd3423f710ea26e42b145147487e.png[/img]

Hey guys ! 

I just wanted to give you some news about the game. 
Gamedev is going well, I've almost finished a first "playable" version of the game and I hope i'll start the testing phase soon.
As you may know it takes time to make a solo indiegame / and I had to make a break to focus on my full-time job and my family :)

Can't wait to share the game with you <3
